a2-14-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Questions for the Craftsperson
a2-14-01.scenario: Lucía has brought the group to a ceramics workshop in Hanoi to interview a friend of hers who is a craftsperson. She asks you to start with two questions about his past: where he worked and when he arrived.
a2-14-01.prompt: Ask the craftsperson where he worked and when he arrived.
a2-14-01.english: Where did you work? When did you arrive?
a2-14-01.canDo: I can ask direct questions about completed past events using the pretérito indefinido.

a2-14-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Lucía Asked
a2-14-02.scenario: After the visit to the ceramics workshop in Hanoi, Carlos's sister Ana calls you and asks what Lucía wanted to know. Lucía asked where the craftsperson worked and wanted to know how the story began.
a2-14-02.prompt: Tell Ana that Lucía asked where the craftsperson worked and that she wanted to know how the story began.
cues: Report the question about the place
Report the question about how it began
a2-14-02.target: Lucía preguntó dónde trabajó el artesano y quiso saber cómo empezó la historia.
a2-14-02.english: Lucía asked where the craftsperson worked and wanted to know how the story began.
a2-14-02.canDo: I can report simple questions using qué, dónde, cuándo and cómo.

a2-14-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Craftsperson's Questions
a2-14-03.scenario: In the ceramics workshop in Hanoi, Meg was looking at the bowls and did not hear the craftsperson's questions. She asks you what he wanted to know. He asked who came to the workshop and which one she chose.
a2-14-03.prompt: Tell Meg that he asked who came and that he wanted to know which one she chose.
cues: Report the question about the people
Report the question about her choice
a2-14-03.target: Preguntó quién vino y quiso saber cuál elegiste.
a2-14-03.english: He asked who came and wanted to know which one you chose.
a2-14-03.canDo: I can report questions about people and things using quién, qué and cuál.

a2-14-04.title: Communicative Challenge: My Question
a2-14-04.scenario: At the ceramics workshop in Hanoi you ask the craftsperson how the craft began. Afterwards Meg, who waited outside, asks what you asked him.
a2-14-04.prompt: Ask the craftsperson how the craft began, then tell Meg what you asked.
a2-14-04.target: ¿Cómo empezó el oficio? Pregunté cómo empezó el oficio.
a2-14-04.english: How did the craft begin? I asked how the craft began.
a2-14-04.canDo: I can ask and report simple questions about an interview and past events.

a2-14-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Interview
a2-14-05.scenario: Carlos's sister Ana calls and asks about the interview at the ceramics workshop in Hanoi. Carlos asked when the craftsperson began, and the craftsperson explained how the craft began.
a2-14-05.prompt: Tell Ana what Carlos asked and what the craftsperson explained.
a2-14-05.target: Carlos preguntó cuándo empezó. El artesano explicó cómo empezó el oficio.
a2-14-05.english: Carlos asked when he began. The craftsperson explained how the craft began.
a2-14-05.canDo: I can recount an interesting interview and report the questions people asked.

a2-14-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What Happened?
a2-14-consolidation.scenario: You arrived late to the visit at the ceramics workshop in Hanoi. You ask Daniela what happened, and then you tell Lucía what Daniela asked you.
a2-14-consolidation.prompt: Ask Daniela what happened, then tell Lucía that Daniela asked when you arrived.
a2-14-consolidation.english: What happened? Daniela asked when I arrived.
a2-14-consolidation.canDo: I can ask and report simple questions about past events.
